Package org.openstreetmap.josm.plugins.websitewizard

Class WebsiteWizardPlugin

java.lang.Object
org.openstreetmap.josm.plugins.Plugin
org.openstreetmap.josm.plugins.websitewizard.WebsiteWizardPlugin
All Implemented Interfaces:
MapFrameListener
public class WebsiteWizardPlugin extends Plugin implements MapFrameListener
Main entry point for the JOSM Website Wizard Plugin. To see changes in JOSM: 1. Save everything and run `ant dist` (`ant clean` probably only helpful before a release. Causes much longer build.) 2. Copy/Paste from ~/git/josm/josm/dist/websitewizard.jar to ~/Library/JOSM/plugins 3. Restart JOSM Docs: https://josm.openstreetmap.de/doc/index.html
